alt: 家長看到牆壁和沙發被油漆潑髒，漲紅臉握緊拳頭，孩子抱著傾倒的漆罐站在旁邊。
scene_prompt: A parent discovers a child has accidentally splashed paint across a freshly cleaned living-room wall and sofa. The parent is extremely furious: red face, tightly clenched jaw, furrowed brows, clenched fists and rigid shoulders, feet planted. The child holds the tipped paint pot and looks worried. Exaggerated but believable expression, no actual smoke, holes, violence or hitting.
